Run the tests with `make`:

- **`make test-fast`** runs the unit suite and skips the Postgres tests. It calls `pytest -m "not postgres" -q`.
- **`make test`** runs everything with `pytest -q`. The Postgres tests need a database, so start it first with `docker compose up db`.
